scope: Bounded, semantics-preserving reduction of repository-context git processes. Every observation point and every never-bypass-fresh-check comparison is kept.

changes.before: rev-parse --verify HEAD, then (on failure) rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD to confirm an unborn repository
changes.after: one rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD: exit 0 is the validated HEAD hash, exit 1 is an unborn repository, any other exit still fails with REPOSITORY_GIT_UNAVAILABLE
changes.equivalence: The quiet and non-quiet forms resolve HEAD identically; the old pair could only reach null through the quiet exit 1, and invalid output from exit 0 still fails the hash check.
changes.saves: one git process per preview in unborn repositories; none in repositories with a commit

changes.before: preview, then query(expectedPreview = that fingerprint), then compare the fingerprint with the query's manifest
changes.after: query, then fingerprint = sha({ manifest, query }) of its result; the trailing preview after snippet reads and verifySources is unchanged and still fails with REPOSITORY_CONTEXT_STALE
changes.equivalence: The removed preview ran immediately before the query's own leading preview with no work between them; the query still compares its leading and trailing previews and the old comparison proved both fingerprints use the same hash.
changes.saves: one preview (3-4 git processes) per prepare

unchanged: RepositoryContextSource.assertFresh keeps its leading preview (before source reads, REPOSITORY_CONTEXT_STALE), the re-observing query and its trailing preview.
Public commands, DB schema 23 and error codes.

measurement.flow: engine-verification 'missing verification resumes' flow in a one-file repository: submit, resumed turn, verify_changes approval, completion
measurement.method: spawn counter around node:child_process (syncBuiltinESMExports) in an otherwise identical script; before = sources stashed and engine rebuilt at the base commit. Counts cover the run from submit to completion; workspace setup adds 5 more (totals 276/208/84/64 before, 199/199/64/64 after).
measurement.qualification: Most engine fixtures use unborn repositories, so test runs gain most; a user repository with commits gains about 4% in this flow. Single local runs on darwin arm64; elapsed times are not claimed.

verification.localWholeGate: Deliberately not run locally at the user's request to limit load; acceptance of the whole suite rests on hosted CI.

followUp: PERF-GIT-02: assertFresh runs 3 times per turn with 4 previews each (leading, query leading/trailing, trailing). Collapsing any of them removes a freshness observation point or changes the REPOSITORY_CONTEXT_STALE/REPOSITORY_SOURCE_STALE codes, so it needs an explicit contract decision.
